# 1. Coordinated Siege Focus Directive (3-year cooldown, 2-year buff to all loyal co-belligerent subjects)
oe_van_v97_dir_siege_focus = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        is_subject = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        any_subject = { count >= 1 }
    }
    allow = {
        at_war = yes
        gold >= 75
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = oe_van_v97_war_dir_cd_tt
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_van_v97_war_dir_cd }
        }
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = oe_van_v97_has_war_sub_tt
            oe_van_v97_has_loyal_war_subject = yes
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_van_v97_dir_siege_focus.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -75
            set_variable = { name = oe_van_v97_war_dir_cd months = 36 }
            every_subject = {
                limit = {
                    at_war = yes
                    NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
                    liberty_desire < 50
                    any_current_war = { is_in_war = root }
                }
                oe_van_v97_apply_role_siege = yes
            }
            oe_van_v97_maybe_fire_war_council = yes
        }
    }
}
